mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ums_member_settlement_debt (member_id, source_type, source_id, amount, repaid_amount, status, due_time, create_time) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{amount}, 0, 0, #{dueTime}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, source_type, source_id, amount, repaid_amount, status, due_time FROM ums_member_settlement_debt WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,member_id,source_type,source_id,amount,repaid_amount,status,due_time FROM ums_member_settlement_debt WHERE member_id=#{memberId} AND source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_id=#{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ums_member_settlement_debt SET repaid_amount = repaid_amount + #{amount}, status = IF(repaid_amount >= amount, 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND repaid_amount + #{amount} <= amount
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ums_member_settlement_debt WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 0 AND due_time <= NOW()
